description: This is a PHP source file defining the ClaimAttachmentAPI class within the OrangeHRM Claim module. The class provides REST API endpoints for managing claim attachments, including listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting claim attachments. It leverages traits for common functionality and uses annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing claim attachments within the OrangeHRM Claim module, including listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting attachments.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all claim attachments for a specific request ID, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new attachment to a specific claim request, including processing the uploaded file.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets the attachment data on the ClaimAttachment entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Returns a partial representation of a ClaimAttachment entity for API response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified attachments from a claim request.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific attachment by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing claim attachment, including optional updating of file and description.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing claim attachments, primarily for pagination and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new claim attachment, including request ID, file data, and optional description.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting attachments, specifying request ID and attachment IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single attachment by request ID and attachment ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an attachment, including optional description and file data.
